description: This file defines a React component 'PolicyList' for managing and displaying access control policies in the Mattermost admin console, including search, pagination, and policy actions.

methods.name: fetchPolicies
methods.description: Fetches policies from the server with optional search term and pagination, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, triggers policy fetch with search term.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of policies, updating pagination state.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Loads the previous page of policies, updating pagination state.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns a formatted resource count message for a given policy.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a policy by ID and refreshes the policy list.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates data grid rows from policies, including actions and click handlers.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines columns for the data grid.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates and returns pagination display info.
